conditions_notes: Evaporator saturation temperature from evaporator-outlet pressure. For zeotropic blends use dew reference for superheat/evaporating saturation.
Condensing saturation temperature from condenser-outlet/high-side pressure. For zeotropic blends use bubble reference for subcooling.
Pressure and temperature should represent the same evaporator-outlet region.
Use saturation temperature derived from compressor-suction pressure; distinguish from evaporator superheat when suction-line pressure drop exists.
Condenser-outlet subcooling. Use bubble saturation reference for zeotropic blends.
Use representative evaporator entering/return air. For applications that define TD from box temperature, MEAS_BOX_T may be substituted by the application rule.
Dry-bulb delta-T alone is not a complete charge/airflow diagnosis.
Use compressor service-point pressures and absolute pressure. ATM_PSI should be configurable if elevation compensation is added.
1.08 is the traditional standard dry-air coefficient; actual coefficient varies with humidity/density.
